svg.aria-label: SDLC · from git push to production
svg.title: SDLC · from git push to production
svg.text: SDLC · from git push to production
Build once, in-cluster. Then every environment repeats one pattern: a person merges a change to main, Argo CD reads it, OpenChoreo
deploys the same signed release and Kyverno checks it against Harbor.
A developer merges reviewed code to main in the app repo
Build & sign polls main every minute and builds each new commit in-cluster, on the management cluster
Build & sign scans the image, signs it with the platform key and pushes it to Harbor
Build & sign commits the image digest to deploy/ on main; deploy/ changes never start a build
Argo CD reads the new digest on main and OpenChoreo cuts one immutable release
OpenChoreo deploys the new release to development automatically
The team merges a staging PR that picks the release running in development
Argo CD reads staging.yaml on main
OpenChoreo deploys the same release to staging
The promotion gate starts when the staging rollout succeeds and checks staging: readiness, smoke tests, alerts, 5xx error rate, freeze
The promotion gate opens a production PR with that release only if every check passes
A code owner approves and merges the production PR
Argo CD reads production.yaml on main, outside freeze windows
OpenChoreo submits the same release to production
Kyverno in every environment checks each image's signature, attestations and digest in Harbor against the platform key: it warns in
development and staging and blocks unverified pods in production
Roll back by reverting the production PR. A failed scan, gate check or admission check stops the release where it is.
workload cluster (local default: one cluster, one namespace per environment; multicluster: production on its own)
numbered step: arrow from the component that acts
